notes.title: PVE3 and PVE4 official server archive rollback
notes.notes:
In PVE mode, some people used grenade explosions and other methods to maliciously destroy many totems in PVE mode rooms and demolish a large number of buildings. Therefore,  the archives of PVE3 and PVE4 servers with greater impact have been rolled back to one day ago. The totems can be damaged has been disabled, We have urgently updated the server and the client does not need to be updated. 
We will ban those who maliciously use game bugs or cheating programs to destroy other players' gaming experience, We will block the account after we detect it with Anti-cheat system or receive reports from other players.

notes.title: v1.34 PVP adjustments and important fixes
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] ☑ We have added a server ban function. Anyone who maliciously uses cheating program to ruin other players' gaming experience will be permanently banned. If you see a player violating the rules on the Official Servers, please record a video and join the discord or send us email to provide evidence.
[*] ☑ Greatly increased the durability of ice buildings, wooden buildings, and stone buildings, so that no one can easily destroy your buildings in PVP mode. Note that you must protect your totems and interact with them, and all buildings can only be protected within the green range of the totems. The spiked wall door can also be locked.
[*] ☑ Add the function of placing a password lock on the greenhouse door, greatly increased the durability of the two greenhouses
[*] ☑ Totems can be destroyed in any mode. Totems can be authorized to multiple people again, so you must place the totems in the spiked wall or your own house and lock the door with a password lock to prevent others from destroying and interacting with the totems. The reason for this change is that a large number of totems in the PVE mode are arbitrarily built to occupy a large area of ​​land, causing the PVE server to be full, making it impossible for novice players to play the game.
[*] ☑ Repair the problem of float buildings,  Recheck the support every 10 minutes, and the floating buildings on the server without support will automatically collapse , Note: This is a check function only for server buildings, and the stand-alone mode and personal server are not affected
[*] ☑ Add fertilizer craft
[*] ☑ Adjusted the weapon damage. The damage between players in PVP mode is reduced to 20% of the original weapon damage value, and the damage to animals unchanged. This is conducive to the balance of PVP, so there will be no one-shot kill situation.
[*] ☑ Optimized, improved and re-enabled the active aggressive AI animal generator, which increased the difficulty of the game. Animals will actively look for you in about 20 minutes,
[*] ☑ Enable fall damage, so be careful, life is precious
[*] ☑ Hide the player's health bar, so player will not be easily discovered in PVP mode
[*] ☑ Fixed an issue where animals sometimes didn't respond to the player
[*] ☑ Adjust the server's Ice, tree, and ore resources regeneration time to 1 day in reality, so all resources will become rare and precious. This is only for the server, single-player mode and personal servers are not affected
[*] ☑ All animals in PVE mode can damage player buildings, Please repair your previous buildings in time, use a mallet hit to repair the buildings within totem range
[*] ☑ Add the last  3 digits of the steam ID to the player's nickname to display the player name to distinguish players to prevent duplicate names from impersonating others
[*] ☑ Fixed the bug that when the hot bar is full and stacking items mistake
[*] ☑ Fix when taming an animal, lose control of the character when riding immediately after taming
[*] ☑ Fixed the bug that wood and other items not refreshed in the furnace and campfire on the server
[*] ☑ Modified the summoning logic to prevent pets from getting stuck in buildings
[*] ☑ Readjusted the prices of ammunition and weapons
[*] ☑ When trading with NPCs, prohibit the right-click of the mouse to sell items to prevent players from mistakenly operating the right-click
[*] ☑ The server's various parameters support dynamic runtime configuration 
[*] ☑ Turn off unnecessary ticks for optimization and improvement, greatly reducing the consumption of the server CPU and reducing latency
[*] ☑ Reduce the experience value when harvesting the planted tree to 500
[*] ☑ Add multiple new random player start points
[*] ☑ Add a new trader by the lake in the Snow Village map. You can find him through the small icon. It is also forbidden to build in the area near him
[*] ☑ Extend the duration of planting watering. It can last for 1 hour when fully watered
[*] ☑ Adjust the landscape of the Snow Village hut
[*] ☑ Adjust the collision of small items such as raw meat and keys
[*] ☑ Increase the burning time of fuel in ground torches and wall torches. One piece of wood burns for 20 minutes, and one piece of charcoal can burn for 30 minutes
[*] ☑ Temporarily cancel the attribute added effect after eating vegetables. This function will be opened after adjustment
[*] ☑ Adjust character skill upgrades
[*] ☑ Increase the production cost of  grenades and remote bombs
[/olist]

notes.title: Attention: About floating buildings and totems and update preview
notes.notes:
We will update in 1 day，Here are some previews of this update. This is only for the players on the server. The stand-alone game model will not be affected, but it will have a certain impact on the buildings of the server players.
[olist]
[*] After the update, Totems can be destroyed in any mode. Change back to allow multiple people to interact with totem, so you need to place the totems in your own house and lock the door with a password lock to prevent others from destroying and interacting with your totems. The reason for this change is that a large number of totems in the PVE mode are arbitrarily built to occupy a large area of ​​land, causing the PVE server to be full, making it impossible for novice players to play the game. In the long run, the server will crash due to a large amount of data. It cannot be allowed to be built like this. The start point area will also be prohibited from construction. After the update, animals will also damage player buildings, so a circle of spiked walls must be built for defense.
[*] About floating buildings, The server will check the support every 10 minutes. Floating buildings without support on the server will automatically collapse. If you have such floating buildings on the server, Please recycle your items in the storage box of the floating building. , Note: This is a check function only for server buildings, stand-alone mode and personal servers are not affected
[*] 
[/olist]

notes.title: Will be free for a limited time!
notes.notes:
h2]The game will be free for a limited time! [/h2]
We will make the game free for a limited time. Hurry up and notify your friends to claim the game. You can play the game online with your friends. After claiming it, it will be permanently stored in your library and you will enjoy all future updates!
[h3]Impact on current players [/h3]
[b]If you have already purchased this game, please apply for a refund and choose to store it after the game is free. The official Steam customer service will refund you. [/b]
[h3]Why we're making the game free?[/h3]
We will invite all players to and testing to collect feedback in order to better improve the game.
[h3]When will it be free? [/h3]
According to the requirements of the official Steam customer service, it will take a week after this announcement is issued for the official to set it to free status. In addition to the processing time of the Steam customer service, it is estimated that it will be free in 10-16 days. You can add it to your attention or wish list or shopping cart first. Please wait patiently.
